mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_loading_report(instance_id,pod_id,sequence,reported_at,received_at,models) VALUES (#{instanceId},#{podId},#{sequence},#{reportedAt},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CAST(#{models} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT(instance_id) DO UPDATE SET sequence=EXCLUDED.sequence, reported_at=EXCLUDED.reported_at, models=EXCLUDED.models, received_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE model_loading_report.pod_id=EXCLUDED.pod_id AND model_loading_report.sequence < EXCLUDED.sequence AND model_loading_report.reported_at <= EXCLUDED.reported_at
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (pod_id) * FROM model_loading_report WHERE reported_at >= #{since} ORDER BY pod_id, reported_at DESC, received_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM model_loading_report WHERE reported_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 day'
